overview: Government agencies gain controlled access to OpenAI’s cybersecurity model via AWS GovCloud.
Enterprises adopt GPT‑6.1 Sol for cost‑effective, auditable AI agents in service workflows.
Consumer AI expands into home security and media creation with Gemini and ChatGPT features.

top.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
top.summary: OpenAI’s Daybreak Red, featuring GPT‑5.6 Cyber, is now available on AWS GovCloud (US‑East) for approved government users, enabling secure vulnerability research and mitigation within regulated cloud environments.

top.title: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
top.summary: DevRev integrates GPT‑6.1 Sol and GPT‑6 Astra into its Computer and Operator agents, delivering reversible, source‑referenced actions for enterprise service tasks while balancing speed, cost, and alignment.

top.title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system
top.summary: AT&T’s Connected Life system adds Gemini for Home, allowing natural‑language video search, event summaries, and automated arming based on proximity, available to paid monitoring subscribers.

top.title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
top.summary: ChatGPT now supports GIF creation and editing via the Images 2.6 model, letting users generate, speed‑adjust, and frame‑edit animated images directly in the chat interface.

top.title: Can Large Language Models Review the Scientific Literature? A Test Against a 102-Article Benchmark
top.summary: A study tests large language models’ ability to review scientific literature against a 102‑article benchmark, evaluating their comprehension and summarization accuracy.

top.title: Towards Robust Long-Lived Agents: Benchmarking Experience Lifecycles in Evolving Environments
top.summary: Researchers propose a benchmark for long‑lived AI agents, measuring performance across evolving environments to assess robustness over extended experience cycles.
